objects.description: [Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) gathered information from SQL servers and Building Management System (BMS) servers during [Leviathan Australian Intrusions](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0049).(Citation: CISA Leviathan 2024)
